dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about Mingxing Jewelry.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Mingxing Jewelry is a Liyue trader of precious stones and gems that has been around for hundreds of years.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: You could say it is the Rex Lapis of the market for precious stones. It is the only store of its kind, and it has been in business continuously since the day it was founded.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Have you ever heard anyone mention our Lucent Crescent ornaments? They are especially popular with young people.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: We produce a very limited quantity of Lucent Crescent — only ten per month. People say that if you manage to purchase one of them, you are sure to win the heart of your beloved...

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Interested? Heh... Whether what they say is true or not I don't know, but I do know that I, personally, would be won over if someone was to buy one for me...
